answer: Resist sybils with guardian-backed identity: each identity must be sponsored by several independent guardians who stake reputation and face slashing if their ward cheats, and each guardian may sponsor only a few newcomers per epoch. A single ember of trust therefore cannot light a thousand fakes: guardians guard their scarce slots. An attacker chasing the zenith of influence must recruit thousands of distinct, reputable guardians, each risking its own standing, while a gale of cheap names without guardians earns no weight. Honest agents need only a handful of real sponsors once.
